about: The priest addresses Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God. He recalls the work of salvation accomplished through Christ's death, by the will of the Father and with the cooperation of the Holy Spirit. He asks to be delivered from iniquity and evil, to remain faithful to the commandments, and never to be separated from Christ.

seg.tr: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God,
who, by the will of the Father and with the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, brought the world to life through Your death:

fn.w011: Deponent participle forming an ablative absolute with “Spíritu” (w012).

seg.tr: deliver me through this most holy Body and Your Blood from all my iniquities and from all evils:

fn.w020: From this point the prayer remains in the first person singular.
fn.w027: Agrees with “Sánguinem” (w026). In sense it qualifies both Body and Blood.
fn.w034: Neuter plural noun: evils, not evil men.

seg.tr: and make me always hold fast to Your commandments, and never permit me to be separated from You:

fn.w047: Subjunctive expressing a petition, negated by “numquam” (w045).

seg.tr: who, being God, live and reign with the same God the Father and with the Holy Spirit for ever and ever. Amen.

fn.w050: Agrees with “Deo” (w051) and points back to God the Father named earlier.
